name: mount-security-options-v1
description: flags writable volume mounts that do not set the noexec bind mount option
remediation: Set bindMountOptions to [noexec, nosuid, nodev] on the volume mount, or mark the mount readOnly. Requires Kubernetes v1.37+ with the VolumeBindMountOptions feature gate enabled and a container runtime advertising mount_options support; the field alone does not enforce without both.

controlConfigInputs.name: Mount allow list
controlConfigInputs.description: Mount paths exempt from the noexec bind mount option requirement (e.g. paths needing script execution).
